Clicking 'Pull Live Data' fires the native window.confirm warning ('⚠️ This REPLACES this preview's products, categories, navigation and banners…'), which was CANCELLED per instructions (production export not yet deployed). Regression: sections 1 (Main Menu), 2 (Labels), 3 (Default Page Banner) all render normally; Shop Tabs bulk modal still opens for a 3-row selection with 'Tiles page / New tab / ALL TILES…' options; destination chips (green FLOOR TILES / PORCELAIN) still render in the parent table. No data was mutated in this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: preview_sync_pull self-guard: relies on x-forwarded-host to detect self behind k8s ingress — good — but if REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is unset in backend env, that fallback set becomes empty and only forwarded-host protects self-pull. Consider also checking PUBLIC_PREVIEW_URL/PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from .env (both present).

_run_preview_sync does db[coll].delete_many({}) then insert_many — a partial failure (network drop mid-loop) leaves target collection empty until next successful pull. Status doc reflects it, but the destructive delete-first pattern is risky. Consider bulk_write with upsert-by-id or a swap-collection strategy.

Inherit-from-series uses the `series` field only, but the Materials Manager visually groups by display_name/'{Family} Series' header (e.g. Alabaster Series row shows both LP-1611 and LP-8811). Users seeing sibling rows in the grouped table may reasonably expect Inherit to see them as inheritable — worth aligning the fixture or the header logic (or extending inherit to also consider display_name-collection when series is empty).
supplier_sync.py is still >14.9k lines — extracting preview-sync + shop-tabs into dedicated routers has been recommended in prior iterations and is overdue.
